name: agent-plugin-standards
description: Conventions for authoring plugins — the layout, composition, naming, and versioning that keep one loadable and legible. Covers the directory and manifest layout, pointing at a script the plugin ships and the tests that come with it, composing via declared first-party dependencies, whether a plugin is ambient or on-demand and what may therefore depend on it, the names the platform refuses, what a description says and which copy of it is displayed, and the minor-versus-patch test. Depends on writing-styles for the instructional-writing style its prose follows, and on markdown-standards for the Markdown itself.
